# YZA

> YZA is a women-run design studio and artisan atelier in Guéliz, Marrakech, Morocco, founded by Nawal Rmili. Handmade raffia bags, raffia bag charms, raffia jewelry (earrings, necklaces), and ready-to-wear clothing in a house fabric called Jawhara. Small-batch, limited editions — no two pieces are identical, and the maker's first name is on every tag. Sells direct-to-consumer worldwide (WhatsApp-guided ordering, no automated checkout) and wholesale to concept stores, boutique hotels, and gift shops.

## Products
- [Sacs panier en raphia / Raffia basket bags](https://yza-shop.com/collections/sacs): La Sculpture and La Nouvelle Vague baskets, hand-woven from raffia, doum palm, and banana leaf, with leather trim.
- [Charms en raphia / Raffia bag charms](https://yza-shop.com/collections/charms): hand-crocheted fruit charms that clip onto a bag.
- [Bijoux en raphia / Raffia jewelry](https://yza-shop.com/collections/bijoux): fruit-shaped raffia earrings and necklaces.
- [Prêt-à-porter Jawhara / Ready-to-wear](https://yza-shop.com/collections/pret-a-porter): no-size tops, pareo skirts, and palazzo/wrap pants cut from Jawhara fabric.

## Key facts
- Founded by Nawal Rmili. 100% women-run atelier at 66 rue Yougoslavie, Guéliz, Marrakech, Morocco.
- Every piece is handmade — woven, crocheted, sewn, or embroidered — and no two pieces are alike.
- Lifetime repair guarantee at the Guéliz atelier, whatever the piece's age.
- 30-day return window after delivery (unworn, original condition); returns are free on non-personalized pieces; defective pieces are taken back at no cost.
- Ships internationally; orders are guided step by step over WhatsApp, not an automated checkout form.
- Wholesale / B2B program for concept stores, boutique hotels, and gift shops: short-run orders, order templates, and a free display kit — see the wholesale page below.
